## About
Treasure Tires & Auto is a tire and auto shop at 2730 Austell Rd in Marietta. We sell new and used tires, repair tires, do wheel alignments and handle auto repair, from everyday cars to business trucks.
Our mission is to get you on the road in tires that are safe and priced competitively. We'd rather explain what your car needs than push you into spending more.
Neighbors have given us a 4.7 rating across 313 Google reviews. Give us a call and we'll find you a time.

## Services
- Wheel Alignment: Alignments done with modern equipment, at a price that makes sense.
- New Tires: Safe tires at competitive prices, sold your way.
- Used Tires: Graded used tires that cost less than new and are just as dependable.
- Auto Repair: Repair and maintenance for your car, plus heavy-duty repairs.
- Tire repair: Tire repair and alignment work done by our technicians.

## FAQ
Q: Will my vehicle cost extra?
A: Some vehicles and services take more time, labor or special equipment, like heavy-duty trucks, Jeeps, European vehicles, SUVs, vans and EVs. Call us and we'll tell you about any extra charges up front.

Q: Are used tires safe?
A: Our grading specialists check every used tire so only the good ones go on the rack. Safety is never sacrificed.
